goal: Round 2 of the #3943 custody fix (both slot reviews returned REVISE/findings on generation 1): (1) comparison-operand literals in the concurrency group expression are NO LONGER redacted — the redactor scans true paired single-quoted literals and leaves verbatim any whose preceding text ends in == or !=, so retargeting inputs.target or github.event_name discriminators is refused (the merged-cross-target-queue outcome by retarget, both reviewers' blocking finding); (2) the scan is positional, not a regex alternation, so a skipped operand cannot shift a match start onto its closing quote; (3) the code comment states the true tolerated set and the fail-closed assumptions (single-line group form, single-quoted queue literals, escaped-apostrophe ordinal drift); (4) new refusal tests for both discriminator reproducers, and a sanity assertion in the rename-tolerance test.
assumptions: Tolerated set, stated truly: in-place renames of NON-operand (queue-position) single-quoted literals; and position-preserving same-count exchanges among them. Fail-closed when assumptions break: folded or sequence-form group lines, double-quoted queue spellings, escaped apostrophes.
